    <sectionSummaryBrief>Simply, the true and complete redemption of all Israel throughout all generations will occur very soon.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And simply – that in the very near future there will be the true and complete redemption of all Israel throughout all the generations,</t>
    <t s="1">souls in bodies,</t>
    <t s="2">through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="3">speedily in our actual times.</t>
  </section>
